pages.text: Rust beetles chew hematite spheres out of the soil and shed iron flakes. Stonegrazers move in small herds and lick salts from the rocks; feed them gypsum crystals to breed them.

Careful in the canyons: a canyon lurker folded up looks like one more rock until you come close. Polar worms bite with a numbing chill if provoked, and in strong storms living dust devils chase anything that moves.
